metas.name: American Manhunt: O.J. Simpson
metas.description: The white Bronco. The gloves. The trial of the century. This documentary series investigates the shocking murder case that became a cultural phenomenon.

metas.name: Deadliest Warrior
metas.description: Deadliest Warrior was a television program in which information on historical or modern warriors and their weapons are used to determine which of them is the "deadliest" based upon tests performed during each episode. The show was characterized by its use of data compiled in creating a dramatization of the warriors' battle to the death. The show ran for three seasons.

metas.name: The Reluctant Traveller with Eugene Levy
metas.description: Award-winning actor and nervous explorer Eugene Levy steps out of his comfort zone for a whirlwind tour of the world's most beautiful and intriguing destinations.

metas.name: Pretty Baby: Brooke Shields
metas.description: Actor, model, and global superstar Brooke Shields’ journey from a sexualized young girl to a woman who embraces her identity and voice.

metas.name: Exterminate All the Brutes
metas.description: Hybrid docuseries offering an expansive exploration of the exploitative and genocidal aspects of European colonialism, from America to Africa, and its impact on society today.

metas.name: Trainwreck: Woodstock '99
metas.description: Woodstock 1969 promised peace and music, but its '99 revival delivered days of rage, riots and real harm. Why did it go so horribly wrong?

metas.name: House of Secrets: The Burari Deaths
metas.description: Suicide, murder... or something else? This docuseries examines chilling truths and theories around the deaths of 11 members of a Delhi family.

metas.name: Sean Combs: The Reckoning
metas.description: A revealing look at Sean 'Diddy' Combs' journey from music mogul to high-profile sexual offender, featuring footage and insider accounts that expose both his groundbreaking success with Bad Boy Entertainment and the troubling shadows behind his empire.

metas.name: How to Become a Tyrant
metas.description: The documentary series explores different political figures throughout history.

metas.name: I'll Be Gone in the Dark
metas.description: An exploration of the case of the Golden State Killer who terrorized California in the 1970s and 1980s, committing 50 sexual assaults and 10 murders, and true crime author Michelle McNamara's obsessive quest to find justice on behalf of his victims.

metas.name: High Score
metas.description: This docuseries traces the history of classic video games, featuring insights from the innovators who brought these worlds and characters to life.

metas.name: I Love You, Now Die: The Commonwealth v. Michelle Carter
metas.description: Teen Michelle Carter’s actions shocked a nation — but what really happened behind closed doors?

metas.name: Dark Tourist
metas.description: The definition of "tourism" is redefined as New Zealand filmmaker David Farrier sets his sights on the world of dark tourism.  From nuclear tourism in Japan to Pablo Escobar-inspired tourism in Colombia to frontier tourism in Turkmenistan, David visits the world’s grisly and offbeat destinations, meeting travelers drawn to them, and the people telling these stories day after day.

metas.name: FIFA Uncovered
metas.description: From power struggles to global politics, an exploration of FIFA reveals the organization's checkered history — and what it takes to host a World Cup.

metas.name: The Program: Cons, Cults, and Kidnapping
metas.description: Years after being sent to a disciplinary school, a woman still haunted by her experiences exposes the corruption and abuse of the troubled teen industry.

metas.name: Surviving R. Kelly
metas.description: Celebrated as one of the greatest R&B singers of all time, R. Kelly’s genre defining career and playboy lifestyle has been riddled with rumors of abuse, predatory behavior, and pedophilia. Despite damning evidence and multiple witnesses, to date, none of these accusations have seemingly affected him. For the first time ever, survivors and people from R. Kelly’s inner circle, are coming forward with new allegations about his sexual, mental, and physical abuse. They are now finally ready to share their full story and shed light on the secret life the public has never seen.

metas.name: Age of Samurai: Battle for Japan
metas.description: Dynamic reenactments and expert commentaries bring to life the tumultuous history and power struggles of a warring 16th-century feudal Japan.

metas.name: The Putin Interviews
metas.description: A revealing series of interviews between renowned filmmaker Oliver Stone and Vladimir Putin in which the Russian President speaks candidly on the US Election, Trump, Syria, Snowden and more.

metas.name: Shiny Happy People
metas.description: A limited docuseries exposing the truth beneath the wholesome Americana surface of reality tv’s favorite mega-family, The Duggars, and the radical organization behind them: The Institute in Basic Life Principles. As details of the family and their scandals unfold, we realize they’re part of an insidious, much larger threat already in motion, with democracy itself in peril.

metas.name: Murder on Middle Beach
metas.description: A four-part documentary series revolving around the case of single mother Barbara Hamburg, who was brutally murdered in 2010 near her home in the upper-middle class enclave of Madison, Connecticut. The series presents first-time filmmaker Madison Hamburg’s complicated journey as a young man determined to solve an unspeakable crime and absolve the people he loves, while looking for answers within his fractured family and community.

metas.name: Homicide
metas.description: Detectives and prosecutors revisit their most challenging homicide cases in this chilling true-crime docuseries.

metas.name: Surviving Black Hawk Down
metas.description: In extraordinary detail, US soldiers and Somali fighters recall the 1993 Battle of Mogadishu and the now-famous downing of three Black Hawk helicopters.

metas.name: Dateline
metas.description: Dateline NBC, or simply Dateline, is a weekly American television newsmagazine series. It was previously the network's flagship newsmagazine, but now focuses mainly on true crime stories with only occasional editions that focus on other topics.

metas.name: Who Killed Little Gregory?
metas.description: When their 4-year-old son is murdered, a young couple fights a twisting and arduous battle trying to identify a frustratingly elusive killer.

metas.name: Killer Inside: The Mind of Aaron Hernandez
metas.description: Via interviews with friends, players and insiders, this docuseries examines how Aaron Hernandez went from an NFL star to a convicted killer.

metas.name: Keep Sweet: Pray and Obey
metas.description: In interviews and rare home video footage, ex-FLDS members share the truth about their isolated community — and the events that pushed them to leave.

metas.name: Unsolved Mysteries
metas.description: Real cases of perplexing disappearances, shocking murders and paranormal encounters fuel this gripping revival of the iconic documentary series.

metas.name: Ancient Apocalypse
metas.description:
Journalist and writer Graham Hancock travels the globe hunting for evidence of mysterious, lost civilizations dating back to the last Ice Age.

He attempts to prove that a climatic event 12,000 years ago wiped out an entire civilization far more sophisticated than the simple hunter-gatherers some archaeologists believe lived at that time.

metas.name: Conversations with a Killer: The Jeffrey Dahmer Tapes
metas.description: Serial killer Jeffrey Dahmer confesses to his gruesome crimes in unguarded interviews, offering an unsettling view into a disturbed mind.

metas.name: The Confession Killer
metas.description: Henry Lee Lucas rose to infamy when he confessed to hundreds of unsolved murders. This docuseries examines the truth -- and horrifying consequences.

metas.name: Madoff: The Monster of Wall Street
metas.description: This docuseries follows the rise and fall of financier Bernie Madoff, who orchestrated one of the biggest Ponzi schemes in Wall Street history.

metas.name: The Innocent Man
metas.description: In a story that gained national attention with John Grisham’s best-selling non-fiction book, The Innocent Man: Murder and Injustice in a Small Town, the six-part documentary series The Innocent Man focuses on two murders that shook the small town of Ada, Oklahoma, in the 1980s — and the controversial chain of events that followed.

metas.name: Devil in the Family: The Fall of Ruby Franke
metas.description: When popular vlogger Ruby Franke is arrested for child abuse in August 2023, it quickly becomes one of the biggest trending stories in America. For years, the Frankes' YouTube channel had documented a wholesome, happy family life, with nearly 3 million subscribers tuning in at its peak. But as the cracks began to show, the family turned to counselor Jodi Hildebrandt for guidance – and rapidly found themselves trapped in a nightmare.

metas.name: I AM A KILLER
metas.description: Death row inmates convicted of capital murder give a firsthand account of their crimes in this documentary series.

metas.name: Telemarketers
metas.description: This docuseries chronicles the darkly comedic, unexpected 20-year journey of two unlikely office buddies, who stumble upon the murky truth behind the work they’ve been doing at a seedy New Jersey call center – persuading people to give money to charities – and vow to expose the crooked American telemarketing industry from within.

metas.name: Aftershock: Everest and the Nepal Earthquake
metas.description: After a terrible earthquake in Nepal, locals and tourists join forces to face destruction in this gripping docuseries.

metas.name: Break Point
metas.description: Travel alongside some of the world's most talented tennis players as they swing for greatness and Grand Slams through an action-packed season.

metas.name: Who Killed Garrett Phillips?
metas.description: The documentary examines and chronicles the years following the 2011 murder of 12-year-old Garrett Phillips and the subsequent trial of Clarkson University soccer coach Oral "Nick" Hillary.

metas.name: Bad Sport
metas.description: True crime and sports come together in this docuseries. Global controversies and scandals are explored through reports from those involved.

metas.name: McMillion$
metas.description: A detailed account of the McDonald's Monopoly game scam during the 1990s as told by the participants in the case, including the prizewinners and the FBI agents who caught the security officer who orchestrated the entire scheme.

metas.name: This Is the Zodiac Speaking
metas.description: In this true-crime docuseries, a family searching for answers shares clues and eye-opening testimonies about the prime suspect in the Zodiac murders.

metas.name: The Vow
metas.description: The docuseries follows people deeply involved in the group NXIVM — which is faced with various charges, including sex trafficking and racketeering conspiracy — over the course of several years.

metas.name: Catching Killers
metas.description: The investigators behind infamous serial killer cases reveal the harrowing, chilling details of their extraordinary efforts in this true crime series.

metas.name: Bad Surgeon: Love Under the Knife
metas.description: Dr. Paolo Macchiarini is world famous for his revolutionary stem cell-infused windpipe transplants. There's just one problem: His patients keep dying.

metas.name: Worst Ex Ever
metas.description: From chilling betrayals to murder plots, this true-crime docuseries dissects the dark side of love through eyewitness testimonies.

metas.name: Trump: An American Dream
metas.description: Friends, associates and critics reveal the truly American story of Donald Trump, the brash businessman who defied the odds to become U.S. president.

metas.name: Robbie Williams
metas.description: After 25 years of his record-breaking solo career, Robbie looks back on his younger self and reflects on a lifetime spent in the spotlight.

metas.name: Love Has Won: The Cult of Mother God
metas.description: Chronicles the life and death of Amy Carlson, also known as Mother God, a self-proclaimed spiritual savior who built a cult through her online manifestos and live-streaming sessions. As Amy's health declined, her followers believed her death would lead to her evacuation by UFO and salvation for humanity. Told through the eyes of Amy's devotees and constructed from the cult's archival footage, the three-part docuseries captures the perils of internet proselytizing and a conspiracy-driven faith.

metas.name: Unabomber: In His Own Words
metas.description: Anchored by a rare interview, this docuseries details Ted Kaczynski's path from a young intellectual to one of the most feared people in US history.

metas.name: Inside the World's Toughest Prisons
metas.description: Crime journalist Raphael Rowe goes behind the bars of some of the world’s most notorious and toughest prisons. Immersing himself in maximum security facilities around the world to live as a prisoner, he encounters the inmates locked up for their crimes and meets the men and women on the right side of law tasked with keeping the criminals behind bars.

metas.name: Rotten
metas.description: This docuseries travels deep into the heart of the food supply chain to reveal unsavory truths and expose hidden forces that shape what we eat.

metas.name: Phoenix Rising
metas.description: Actress and activist Evan Rachel Wood takes her experience as a survivor of domestic violence and pursues justice, heals generational wounds, and reclaims her story. Almost a decade after escaping a dangerous relationship, Wood co-authors and successfully lobbies for passage of The Phoenix Act, legislation that extends the statute of limitations for domestic violence cases in California.

metas.name: Heaven's Gate: The Cult of Cults
metas.description: What started in 1975 with the disappearance of 20 people from a small town in Oregon, ended in 1997 with the largest suicide on US soil and changed the face of modern New Age religion forever. This four-part docuseries uses never-before-seen footage and first-person accounts to explore the infamous UFO cult that shocked the nation with their out-of-this-world beliefs.

metas.name: Muscles & Mayhem: An Unauthorized Story of American Gladiators
metas.description: In the '90s, TV's stunt-filled "American Gladiators" thrilled fans. This docuseries explores the show's success — and how it almost ended before it began.

metas.name: Stolen Youth: Inside the Cult at Sarah Lawrence
metas.description: A group of bright Sarah Lawrence College students fall under the dark influence of a friend's father, Larry Ray. With unprecedented access to the survivors who lived with Ray, the series follows the cult from its origins through its still-unfolding aftermath.

metas.name: Jeffrey Epstein: Filthy Rich
metas.description: Stories from survivors fuel this docuseries examining how convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein used his wealth and power to carry out his abuses.

metas.name: Conversations with a Killer: The John Wayne Gacy Tapes
metas.description: He dined with the powerful. He preyed on the vulnerable. Beneath a smiling exterior was the horrifying darkness of a sadistic serial killer.

metas.name: American Murder: Gabby Petito
metas.description: What happened in the final days of Gabby Petito's life? In this gripping true-crime series, her loved ones reveal the untold story of her tragic murder.

metas.name: Worst Roommate Ever
metas.description: Roommates with malevolent and sometimes violent intentions turn the lives of their unsuspecting victims into real-life nightmares. These terrifying true stories unveil some of the worst cohabitation experiences one could ever imagine.

metas.name: The Ripper
metas.description: For five years, from 1975 to 1980, the Yorkshire Ripper murders cast a dark shadow over the lives of women in the North of England. 13 women were dead and the police seemed incapable of catching the killer. No one felt safe – and every man was a suspect.

metas.name: Roman Empire
metas.description: This stylish mix of documentary and historical epic chronicles the reign of Commodus, the emperor whose rule marked the beginning of Rome's fall.

metas.name: Fear City: New York vs The Mafia
metas.description: New York City in the 1970s was ruled with a bloody fist by five mafia families, until a group of federal agents tried the unthinkable: taking them down.

metas.name: Gone Girls: The Long Island Serial Killer
metas.description: This tense true-crime series examines the hunt for the Long Island serial killer through the perspective of his victims, their loved ones and the police.

metas.name: Vatican Girl: The Disappearance of Emanuela Orlandi
metas.description: Rome, 1983. After leaving a music lesson, 15-year-old Emanuela Orlandi vanishes — embroiling the Vatican in a decades-long mystery.

metas.name: Trial by Media
metas.description: In this true crime docuseries, some of the most dramatic trials of all time are examined with an emphasis on how the media may have impacted verdicts.

metas.name: AMERICA'S SWEETHEARTS: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders
metas.description: Follow the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders from auditions to training camp and the NFL season as they chase their dreams and a coveted spot on the squad.

metas.name: Cocaine Cowboys: The Kings of Miami
metas.description: Two childhood friends go from high school dropouts to the most powerful drug kingpins in Miami in this true story of a crime sage that spanned decades.

metas.name: World's Most Wanted
metas.description: Heinous criminals have avoided capture despite massive rewards and global investigations. This docuseries profiles some of the world’s most wanted.

metas.name: Leaving Neverland
metas.description: Explores the experiences of James Safechuck and Wade Robson, who were both befriended and sexually abused by singer Michael Jackson, and the complicated feelings that led them both to confront their experiences.

metas.name: Pepsi, Where's My Jet?
metas.description: When a 20-year-old attempts to win a fighter jet in a Pepsi sweepstakes, he sets the stage for a David versus Goliath court battle for the history books.

metas.name: Ancient Aliens
metas.description: Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago? From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate.

metas.name: The Sons of Sam: A Descent into Darkness
metas.description: The Son of Sam case grew into a lifelong obsession for journalist Maury Terry, who became convinced that the murders were linked to a Satanic cult.

metas.name: Sins of Our Mother
metas.description: When Lori Vallow's kids vanished, the search for them unearthed a trail of suspicious deaths, a new husband who shared her doomsday views — and murder.

metas.name: Waco: American Apocalypse
metas.description: This docuseries includes never-before-seen material from the infamous 51-day standoff between federal agents and a heavily armed religious group in 1993.

metas.name: American Murder: Laci Peterson
metas.description: Laci Peterson was eight months pregnant when she vanished, sparking a search that ended in tragedy. This docuseries delves into the 2002 murder case.

metas.name: Murder Among the Mormons
metas.description: High-stakes exploits turn deadly — and shake a global church to its core — in this extraordinary true crime story.

metas.name: Wormwood
metas.description: In this genre-bending tale, Errol Morris explores the mysterious death of a U.S. scientist entangled in a secret Cold War program known as MK-Ultra.

metas.name: McGREGOR FOREVER
metas.description: Conor McGregor's brutal strikes and trash-talking swagger made him the UFC's biggest draw. This rousing documentary series follows his dynamic career.

metas.name: How to Fix a Drug Scandal
metas.description: The four-part docuseries revolves around Amherst, Massachusetts, drug lab chemist Sonja Farak who became addicted to the narcotics she was supposed to be testing. In covering her tracks, Farak falsified thousands of results and opened the door to overturning hundreds of wrongful convictions.

metas.name: Get Gotti
metas.description: Murder. Extortion. Drug smuggling. Racketeering. The charges are mounting against John Gotti — but will any of them stick to the "Teflon Don"? Told from both sides of the law, this docuseries from the makers of "Fear City" follows the FBI's battle to bring down infamous mob boss.

metas.name: Money, Explained
metas.description: We spend it, we borrow it, and save it. Now let's talk about money and its many minefields, from credit cards to casino, scammers to student loans.
